description: This PHP file defines the class 'HeaderFooter' within the PhpOffice\PhpSpreadsheet\Worksheet namespace. It manages header and footer formatting for spreadsheets, including formatting codes, section contents for headers and footers (left, center, right), and associated images. It includes constants for image positions, properties for header and footer content, and methods to get/set these properties, as well as to manage images and cloning of the object.

classes.name: HeaderFooter
